message: 諺・狂歌・散文

name: Paqy
message: 「Thinking ahead to after you've conquered the world and practicing your speeches now, hehehe... That's Synn-sama for ya.」

name: Synn
message: 「J-Just what kind of thought process led you to that conclusion?」
The moment I stepped inside the Culture Hall, Paqy started flattering me in a completely off-base direction, as has become our usual routine.
Huh...? Wait, he called me 'Synn-sama' instead of 'Demon Lord'? Is someone else here?

name: Lolotte
message: 「My loyal and valiant students of Ryuusei Academy! Dare I say it, I am an angel!!」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's what you are after all?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bit late to be realizing that now.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eeeek!! President, how long have you been standing there!? And I am not an angel!」

name: Synn
message: 「Calm down, Lolotte. I'm just patrolling the patrol.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? You sure say weird things, President.」

name: Paqy
message: 「L-Look who's talking...」

name: Synn
message: 「You know how the demons have been getting stronger lately, right? Training the Crusaders is important, of course, but I thought I'd check around the campus again.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hardly anyone ever comes to the Culture Hall, so I was worried it might've turned into a demon nest... Looks like it's fine, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? You really pop up like \{sunset|\s12\s12} all over the place, don't you, President?」

name: Synn
message: 「...What were you doing here all by yourself, Lolotte?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, correct her on that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm so glad you asked! There's going to be a slogan contest for the first-years soon. Exciting!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, we did that last year too. Everyone comes up with a new slogan, and the best ones get awarded at a presentation ceremony in the Culture Hall.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes~♪ So I was doing a dress rehearsal for the award ceremony. Clap, clap.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's amazing, Lolotte! So you won an award!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? You're quite the impatient one, President. I haven't even entered yet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please look forward to it, though! As you can see, proverbs are my absolute specialty, hmph!」

name: Paqy
message: 「How the heck is anyone supposed to tell that just by looking at ya?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief, Mr. Panda, you really have no eye for people.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the great me doesn't have an eye for angels, that's for sure.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「T-t-t-t-t, I am not an angel!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How's that! It's in 5-7-5!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-you don't really need to base it on fixed-form poetry like waka...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, a competition is \{perishable|\s12\s12\s12\s12}, so you never know, right? I'm sure to win a prize.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-no, don't proverbs and slogans have pretty little to do with each other...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's why I'm tellin' ya to correct her!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Exciting, heart-pounding... Mr. President, I'll let you in on the slogans I came up with just for you. Please let me hear your thoughts!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, if you don't mind my opinion.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ahem! 'Gropers are perverts, so let's be careful.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Let's be careful, on dark night roads lurks Blackuma.'」
I-I'm in a huge bind.
It's way too subtly off to explain logically, yet something about Lolotte's slogans is definitely wrong.

name: Lolotte
message: 「How are they, Mr. President♪」
Lolotte gazes at me with sparkling eyes.

name: Paqy
message: 「...Tug, tug.」
Paqy clouds his eyes and tugs on my sleeve.
Correcting an angel's misunderstandings takes a massive amount of time and effort, ain't it? Yours truly refuses to get dragged into that. Let's hurry and bail, Synn-sama!
That's what Paqy is saying through eye contact.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, I still have tons more that I thought up♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I-is that right...」
No good, I have to stay here. I can't just leave Lolotte behind all by herself.

name: Paqy
message: 「The great me is gonna excuse himself first!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah?! The lock's been smashed to bits!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like that'll stop me...! There's still plenty of other exits!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Th-This one won't open either!!」
R-Riesling-san...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. Panda? Why did you suddenly start doing a comedy routine?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm not!!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte... look, a slogan is--」
Carefully choosing my words, I go on to explain what a slogan is.
While Lolotte listened earnestly, the questions she occasionally interjected were all simple yet hit the nail on the head.
Thanks to that, I got to learn a lot right alongside Lolotte.
The remaining problem is...
How to get out of this cultural hall where all the door locks have been destroyed.
